classification: Production-like transition semantics under M7 bounds.

attemptSuccess.reason: no environment draw exists; every traversal succeeds by construction (recorded in every session: traversal a == s on every edge, env counters 0)

finalHop.definition: final-hop attempt = a legal graph-edge move into the active goal; B2 takes no environment draw for it, so every such attempt succeeds and failures are 0 by construction; a draw log reports any draw into the goal (expected none)

predictions.text: C1 holds (calibration under state P: the goal-entry store gave +82.0 [58.9, 105.8] legal reaches; the floor equalled the goal-entry store on every earlier runtime)
C3 holds (the floor was indistinguishable from the goal-entry store on all three earlier runtimes)
the audit and the condition integrity pass: the floor never raises a non-graph candidate and no session installs an environment

verdict: The guarded goal-entry floor with no stored episode improves legal goal reaches over cold by at least the declared margin under production-like transition semantics. It is non-inferior to the goal-entry-episodes ceiling within the margin. A separate production-design review is the supported next step; this result is not an implementation recommendation. Descriptive, not gating: real stored episodes versus cold 4.1 [-6.7, 14.7]; the floor versus real episodes is EXCEEDS. Production-like transition semantics under M7 bounds.
deviations: The 150-tick episode cap (frozen M7 episode rule; production has none).
The deterministic replay cooldown (presence-based; production uses a 4 s wall-clock cooldown).
Legacy stale-keyed credit assignment through agentLast->next (the product's own credit site; temporally misaligned by design and not isolated here).
claimLimits: Condition P installs no environment draw, so traversal-attempt success is identically 1.0; it cannot establish real-world routing capability and is reported as DEGENERATE, never as evidence of success.
FutureScore V2.3 behaves as a pure graph-distance potential under P (learned cost = 1 on every edge).

No claim of production equivalence, production readiness, user-visible quality, safety or general routing capability; nothing outside the frozen goals {8,12,16,19}, the graph, the Phase I 1,500-call budget and the harness semantics.
